{{Quote|A large family, Jabba the Hutt has. Keeping track of all members, difficult it is.|[[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="TVO">''[[The Clone Wars: The Valsedian Operation]]''</ref>}}
'''Desilijic''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan. They were bitter enemies with the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] clan. Members of the Desilijic clan were known for their appreciation of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|females]], extravagant taste, hedonism and expensive palaces. Some of them also had a mutation that resulted in hair. It can also be said that Desilijic was one of the first of the Hutt clans from [[Varl/Legends|Varl]], since it could be represented on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]].<ref name="TF">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref>

==History==
Notorious for being slavers, gangsters, and merciless kingpins, the Desilijic were one of the most ruthless Hutt crime clans in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
[[File:Mama_the_Hutt_LoNH.png|thumb|left|250px|Mama, the oldest living member of the Desilijic clan.]]
The Desilijic clan also controlled some of the most important [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] courses during the [[Old Republic era]], including the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] and the [[Ando Overland]], which gave them a ''de facto'' financial control over [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]] respectively.<ref name="hnn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|sports/13328_1.html|Podracing Faces Uncertain Future}}</ref><ref name="sj">{{GamerCite|2|Snow Job}}</ref> During the Old Republic, the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] repeatedly and vainly attempted to take the control of Ando Prime from the Desilijic clan;<ref name="sj" /> however, [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure|Zorba the Hutt's]] capture in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] was a harder blow for the Desilijic podracing interest, particularly as it coincided with a strong opposition to the sport.<ref name="hnn" />

[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] was one of the most famous of all the Desilijic in the years of the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], having helped drive the clan from economic obscurity resulting from the days of [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure|Zorba's]] reign, to complete dominance over all other Hutt [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]] during the years [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Members of the clan associated themselves with numerous notorious criminal organizations, and many of the clan were killed in incidents of intra-clan and inter-clan rivalry.

[[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron]]'s [[Winter Palace]] was the home of the clan shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
